svg.title: Parameterized Surface and Metric V4
svg.desc: Computed unit-sphere parameterization with coordinate curves, tangent basis and first fundamental form.

g.text: Coordinates become geometry through the metric tensor.
Unit sphere r(θ,φ); coordinate curves and tangent basis are generated from the parameterization.
Coordinate grid and tangent vectors are sampled from r(θ,φ); the visual is generated from the same equations tested below.
